equipment.name: Haywire pulse
equipment.desc:
Roll 1D3 during activation if an enemy vehicle is within 6":
        1 - The vehicle suffers a penetrating hit with AT(1).
        2 - The vehicle suffers a penetrating hit with AT(2).
        3 - The vehicle suffers a penetrating hit with AT(3).

equipment.name: Warsmith
equipment.desc: At the end of its move, the model may attempt to repair a vehicle within 6". On a 4+, one "Weapon destroyed" or "Engine damage" result is removed from the vehicle, or 1 hull point is restored. Alternatively, a vehicle within 6" can reroll a hit roll and a wound or armor penetration roll. Additionally, this model counts as having the "Datasmith" Tech Priest upgrade for Robot units with the "Cybernetica Cortex" ability. Legion Praetor only.

equipment.name: Graviton weapon
equipment.desc: One melee weapon of the model gains the "Grav" and "Haywire" abilities.

equipment.name: Refined optics
equipment.desc: The vehicle gains "Tank Hunter". Vehicles destroyed by this model always explode with a 6" radius.
